name: Simbul’s Synostodweomer

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: For 1 hour, the creature you touch can mend itself with its magic: right after it casts a spell with a spell slot, it can spend unused Hit Dice, up to the slot's level, and regain Hit Points equal to their total plus your spellcasting modifier. In a fight it spends them while it's hurt.
